title: Tests that read this repository instead of a fixture red whenever the estate is mid-flight
body:
`lifecycle_verbs_edit_the_list` and `facade_acceptance::a_no_op_scope_change_is_reported_rather_than_written_twice` name `intent/.canon/st/ST0056.json` and `intent/st/ST0056/**` in their failures (dc and vc, 2026-09-12). Green again once the estate was consistent, so the class stands unfixed and blames whoever is committing. Each such test moves to a fixture tree; hv's to rule, cc's if ruled. Carried in `intent/wip.md` until 2026-09-13.

CLOSED 2026-09-14 18:41Z: Closed as not what it describes (vc, 2026-09-14). Both named tests build common::Fixture, a tempfile::tempdir(): lifecycle_verbs_edit_the_list's fixture() and facade_acceptance's a_no_op_scope_change_is_reported_rather_than_written_twice each write their own ST0056 into it, and neither can reach this repository's ST0056. A fixture's paths are spelled intent/.canon/st/ST0056.json and intent/st/ST0056/** too, so a failure naming them does not show a test read the estate, and the original record (a590c248c) kept only the paths, not the assertion. The next red of either test is read for what it is. No code change.
